title: Declare SQLite the only database and remove the Postgres path
description: CLAUDE.md and README advertise 'SQLite (default) or PostgreSQL', but the Postgres branch is untested and most repositories use `?` placeholders that would not work on it. Remove DB_TYPE=postgres handling, the DB_HOST/DB_PORT/DB_USER/DB_PASSWORD/DB_NAME/DB_SSLMODE variables (including the 'postgres' default password), the lib/pq dependency and the golang-migrate postgres driver from the app and from cmd/migrate / cmd/migrate-down. Update every doc that claims Postgres support. This does not touch CourtHive's own Postgres database.

recommended_model.name: Sonnet 5.5
recommended_model.rationale: Deletion-heavy refactor guarded by the existing test suites.

acceptance_criteria: The app and migrate tools accept only SQLite; setting DB_TYPE to anything else fails at startup with a clear message
lib/pq and the postgres migrate driver are gone from go.mod
No doc claims PostgreSQL support for jim-dot-tennis

context.user_story: As a club operator, I want one supported database so that there is one way to back up and restore.
context.programme: Club-readiness programme (sprints 019-024). Agreed constraints: BHPLTA clubs only; each club self-hosts its own instance; the original author must have no access to any other club's instance (no seeded accounts, no shared or default secrets, no phone-home); passkeys are the default sign-in with passwords as an optional fallback; the captain role is real; SQLite is the only supported database; CourtHive is bundled as an opt-in part of the package so clubs can run their own club championships.
